text.en: Canada is governed by laws, and those laws fit together into one organized system.
text.fr: Le Canada est gouverné par des lois, et ces lois forment ensemble un système organisé.

source.quote: Canada is governed by an organized system of laws.

verification.evidence: Canada is governed by an organized system of laws.

text.en: Laws are rules that are written down. They are there to guide how people live together in society.
text.fr: Les lois sont des règles écrites. Elles servent à guider la façon dont les gens vivent ensemble en société.

source.quote: These laws are the written rules intended to guide people in our society.

verification.evidence: Canada is governed by an organized system of laws. These laws are the written rules intended to guide people in our society.

text.en: Our laws are made by the people we elect to represent us.
text.fr: Nos lois sont faites par les personnes que nous élisons pour nous représenter.

source.quote: They are made by elected representatives.

verification.evidence: These laws are the written rules intended to guide people in our society. They are made by elected representatives.

text.en: Courts settle disagreements, and the police make sure people obey the laws.
text.fr: Les tribunaux règlent les différends, et la police veille à ce que les gens respectent les lois.

source.quote: The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws.

verification.evidence: The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws.

text.en: Every person in Canada must follow the law. That includes judges, politicians and police officers.
text.fr: Toute personne au Canada doit respecter la loi. Cela comprend les juges, les politiciens et les policiers.

source.quote: The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.

verification.evidence: The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.

text.en: Laws help keep order in society. They also give people a peaceful way to settle their disagreements.
text.fr: Les lois aident à maintenir l'ordre dans la société. Elles donnent aussi aux gens un moyen pacifique de régler leurs désaccords.

source.quote: Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes

verification.evidence: Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.

text.en: Laws also show what Canadians value and what they believe.
text.fr: Les lois montrent aussi ce qui compte pour les Canadiens et ce en quoi ils croient.

source.quote: and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.

verification.evidence: Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.
